content: Session-loss and app-state failure modes from whatsmeow issues: (1) Issue #1066 — Signal ratchet advances during encrypt but session persistence fails when context is cancelled mid-encryption (network blip), leaving stale ratchet state in DB; next send fails MAC verification → 401 logout requiring QR re-scan. (2) Issue #1203/#651 — app-state sync LTHash verification mismatch on patch storms (e.g. when a new WhatsApp Web PC connects) → fatal desync → server sends stream end → device removed → 401. Mitigations: persist ratchet state with a context that survives cancellation; treat app-state patch verification failures as non-fatal (skip-broken-patches mode + recovery via full fetch), never let a decode error terminate the session. (3) PN→LID session migration failures (#1027) cause silent encryption errors — dual-identity (phone number vs LID) mapping must be persisted and migrated. (4) fresh-link first outbound sometimes not delivered until inbound (#1095). Session durability (persist-after-encrypt, graceful patch errors) is a core re-pairing-avoidance requirement.
